digest_separation.current_raw_pdf_sha256: per-source; current bytes verified across Google Drive/Aliyun/V100
digest_separation.historical_raw_pdf_sha256: null/HOLD; no prior Drive revision or historical raw digest
digest_separation.source_block_jsonl_sha256: overall file digest plus per-source subset digest
digest_separation.source_block_raw_text_sha256: per SourceBlock rawText value; raw text remains in private archive

level_label_contract.supported_observed_grammar: single digit or ascending digit range; optional repeated fullwidth-parenthesis groups; exact punctuation required
level_label_contract.merged_level_identity: hash over exact source standard ID and raw label; punctuation-sensitive
level_label_contract.unknown_or_ambiguous: raw preserved; parse_status HOLD_UNPARSED; no normalization

page_locator_contract.pdf_page_number_one_based: independent nullable integer; when both PDF values exist, page number must equal index + 1
page_locator_contract.no_inference: printed page label never populates PDF page index or one-based page number
page_locator_contract.current_source_blocks: all 94 have recorded RDF integer printedPage values; block-specific PDF page index/number are UNKNOWN/HOLD

record_kind_contract.source_of_truth: explicit typed record field or source RDF kind mapping
record_kind_contract.forbidden_heuristic: never infer vocabulary versus character from string length, Unicode shape or glyph count

parsing_contract.unknown_unparsed_fields: raw value retained and queryable; normalized value null; parse_status NOT_ATTEMPTED/UNPARSED/AMBIGUOUS/ERROR/HOLD

semantic_validation.mapping_binding: caller must supply independently pinned interface-contract SHA256; schema and source mapping bytes checked against it; validate against pinned source and block index
semantic_validation.raw_field_digest_encoding: UTF-8 exact string bytes; other JSON values sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false; null means captured null, not hidden archive digest
semantic_validation.level_band_digest_encoding: canonical sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON of exact raw_label_term (RDF literal); raw label must equal term.value
semantic_validation.unresolved_band: HOLD_UNPARSED retains raw string and RDF term; null members and merged identity; no DB01 StandardBand projection
semantic_validation.synthetic_locator: synthetic page values may differ from archive; source/block IDs and digest linkage still exact; not source evidence

hsk01_consumption_contract: Mandatory schema plus HS00 semantic validator using trusted pinned contract digest; schema alone is insufficient.
Consume source_record_id, provider identity status, raw PDF/text/block digests and preservation_scope as immutable source provenance.
Do not infer official standard identity from source alias, filename, graph namespace or release label; UNKNOWN/HOLD must propagate.
Preserve every raw level label and punctuation before producing any normalized member-level candidate.
Use source_record_id for source provenance and separate normalized_knowledge_id for Lexeme/HanCharacter/Topic/Competency objects.
Use explicit record_kind; never infer character versus vocabulary from surface length or glyph shape.
Use source_block_id, scope_topic_ref, printed page label and raw text digest; keep PDF page index and one-based PDF page number separate and unknown unless directly mapped.
Unknown fields and parser failures remain preserved/queryable; no silent correction, deduplication or overwrite.
Rights HOLD, publication NOT_AUTHORIZED, historical PDF identity HOLD and visual layout HOLD propagate to all downstream records and outputs.
non_goals: No HSK01 bulk conversion of 11,000 lexical records, 4,288 character memberships, 3,088 characters, 94 SourceBlocks, 9 capabilities or 823 taxonomy categories.
No source-level professional content correction, H07 final standard mapping, CQ/LC, semantic qualification or learning-effect claim.
No SQLite file, public release, rights promotion, SRC01 scope expansion, Task DAG update, qualification receipt, PR or merge.
